name: Kaizen Agro Infrabuild Limited
about: Kaizen Agro Infrabuild Limited, a construction company, engages in the construction and civil works. It offers construction services, such as residential, commercial, and industrial projects, as well as involved in agriculture related business. The company was formerly known as Anubhav Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Kaizen Agro Infrabuild Limited in August 2023. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Kolkata, India.
